newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina says Q2 GDP up 2.6 pct, H1 down 0.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Argentina says Q2 GDP up 2.6 pct, H1 down 0.2 pct.

text.p: Argentina's gross domestic product grew 2.6 percent in the second quarter but declined 0.2 percent in the first half of the year, the Economy Ministry said Wednesday.
The 2.6 percent second-quarter growth compares with a drop of 3.2 percent in the first quarter and a decline of 4.6 percent in the second quarter of 1995.
Gross fixed internal investment was up 7.4 percent in the second quarter but down 4.7 percent in the first half of the year.

The second quarter growth was the first rise in GDP since the "Tequila effect" of the Mexican peso devaluation sent all major Argentine indicators into a tailspin, triggering four negative quarters in a row.
But the 2.6 percent was substantially lower than the 3.2 percent second quarter growth predicted by a ministry official last month.

Production of goods grew 1.6 percent in the second quarter and dropped 1.7 percent in the first half, while production of services rose 3.3 percent in the second quarter and increased 1.4 percent in the first half.
"Production of services was clearly in expansion, particularly the rise in activity of financial institutions," the ministry said in its quarterly report.
